lead: A `[capabilities]` path in a proof's own `nvs.toml` is relative to that file, and a `[storage.<disk>] root` beside it is still relative to the directory `nvs` runs from.
body: A grant spelled from the repository root (`docs/examples/core/Storage/get/disk`) now names a directory under the feature directory and denies everything, while the storage root in the same file must keep that spelling. Write the grant as `disk` or `.`, keep the storage root repo-rooted, and say which is which in the file's comment.
